source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Place the rubber dam, remove the caries, and prepare the hole. On the molding piece, wedge. Clean and blow-dry, and place BP near the marrow on the bottom. Etch with acid etchant, rinse and blow dry. Apply adhesive, blow thin, and illuminate. Aesthetic resin is filled in layers and light-cured in layers for shaping, jaw adjustment and polishing.
